geoKnowledge.title: GEO Knowledge Base
geoKnowledge.description: Learn the basics and best practices of GEO (Geographic Optimization) to help your website stand out in AI-powered search engines.

whyGeoPoints: With the rise of AI-powered search engines and assistants, traditional SEO methods are no longer sufficient.
GEO optimization ensures your website gets optimal search visibility across different geographic locations and language environments.
Through GEO optimization, you can enhance brand awareness and influence in your target markets.
GEO optimization helps improve local search rankings, attracting more potential customers.
sections.contentLocalizationDesc: Create content tailored to specific regions and language groups, ensuring your message resonates with local users.
contentLocalizationPoints: Create content in local languages to avoid semantic deviations from literal translation.
Consider local cultural customs and holidays when creating content.
Use local examples and case studies to enhance content relevance.
sections.technicalOptimizationDesc: Implement technical measures to ensure your website loads quickly and provides a good user experience globally.
technicalOptimizationPoints: Use Content Delivery Network (CDN) to accelerate global access.
Optimize website loading speed to reduce user wait times.
Ensure the website displays correctly across different devices and browsers.
sections.regionalTrafficDesc: Track visit volume from different regions to understand which markets your content is most popular in.
sections.languagePreferenceDesc: Analyze user language usage to optimize multilingual content strategy.
sections.searchTrendsDesc: Monitor search trends in different regions to adjust content strategy in response to changes.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.description: GEO AI is dedicated to helping businesses and individuals optimize their websites for AI-powered search engines and assistants.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: How We Started
story.paragraph1: GEO AI was founded in 2024 by a group of professionals passionate about artificial intelligence and search engine optimization. We observed that as large language models (LLMs) rapidly evolve, traditional SEO methods are no longer sufficient for the new search paradigm.
story.paragraph2: Our team comes from top tech companies and research institutions worldwide, bringing extensive AI and web technology expertise. We believe the future of search engines will go beyond keyword matching to semantic understanding and context-aware intelligent systems.
story.paragraph3: Driven by this vision, we developed the GEO AI Checker to help website owners understand how AI engines work and provide actionable optimization recommendations, enabling their websites to stand out in the AI era.
